scope: Author-proposed dependency routes only; no route sufficiency, formal proof, novelty, or Clay eligibility is established.

routes.scope: Every nontrivial zero, including all heights and multiplicities, with justified spectral/operator domain.
routes.interpretation: Candidate spectral route: a genuine operator and zero identity still require an independent implication to the official RH assertion.
routes.required_proof: A noncircular universal theorem proving all nontrivial zeros lie on the critical line.

routes.scope: Every finite encoded SAT instance under an explicitly fixed uniform deterministic machine model.
routes.interpretation: Candidate equality route through SAT correctness and worst-case polynomial total bit complexity.
routes.required_proof: A fully specified deterministic SAT decision procedure with a rigorous polynomial-time class-reduction argument.

routes.scope: All uniform deterministic polynomial-time algorithms, not bounded circuits or a restricted proof system.
routes.interpretation: Alternative general separation route; restricted lower bounds cannot be promoted to P != NP.
routes.required_proof: An unconditional lower-bound argument separating a language in NP from every polynomial-time deterministic machine.

routes.scope: Official alternative A on three-dimensional Euclidean space with zero forcing and all prescribed smooth divergence-free data.
routes.interpretation: Unforced R3 continuation from an a priori estimate, requiring justification of full data and regularity scope.
routes.required_proof: A complete existence-and-smoothness argument satisfying all official R3 unforced assumptions.

routes.scope: Official alternative B on the three-dimensional periodic domain with zero forcing for all admissible initial data.
routes.interpretation: Unforced periodic continuation requires domain-specific regularity estimates and quantifier coverage.
routes.required_proof: A complete periodic global existence-and-smoothness proof under all Clay hypotheses.

routes.scope: Official alternative C on three-dimensional Euclidean space, with admissible smooth data and smooth forcing.
routes.interpretation: A forced R3 breakdown construction is an alternative to either universal unforced regularity theorem.
routes.required_proof: A full smooth-force R3 breakdown counterexample satisfying the Clay initial, decay, energy and PDE conditions.

routes.scope: Official alternative D in the three-dimensional periodic setting with admissible smooth forcing.
routes.interpretation: A forced periodic breakdown construction is an alternative to global unforced regularity.
routes.required_proof: A fully rigorous smooth-force periodic breakdown satisfying the precise Clay data and forcing hypotheses.

routes.scope: Every compact simple gauge group, four-dimensional continuum and infinite-volume reconstructed nontrivial theory.
routes.interpretation: Candidate constructive route joining continuum limits, axioms, and a positive physical mass gap.
routes.required_proof: A complete reconstruction and positive spectral-gap proof for all required compact simple gauge groups.

routes.scope: Every smooth complex projective variety, every codimension, every rational Hodge class.
routes.interpretation: Candidate cycle-generation route whose primitive reduction and quantifier lifting have not been validated.
routes.required_proof: A universal rational algebraic-cycle representation or a valid counterexample with precisely verified scope.

routes.scope: All elliptic curves over Q; core rank equality and MathOS's optional stronger refined formula are explicitly distinguished.
routes.interpretation: Stronger MathOS proposed refined BSD route; its overlap and sufficiency remain unreviewed.
routes.required_proof: An unconditional proof of the core all-curves rank equality; separately justify the refined leading term and Sha hypotheses if claimed.

routes.scope: Independent reconstruction of the already accepted proof for all closed simply connected three-manifolds.
routes.interpretation: Positive-control benchmark only; Perelman's externally established theorem does not certify a MathOS replay.
routes.required_proof: An independently checked complete replay of the established result with specific theorem-level sources.

candidate_bridges.statement: Prove without assuming RH that a correctly realized self-adjoint spectral correspondence implies the exact zero-location statement for every nontrivial zero.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Universal quantification over nontrivial zeros, all heights, with multiplicity and required analytic continuation.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Operator domain, determinant regularization, completeness and spectral mapping cannot assume the claim being proved.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Search for zeros not represented, multiplicity loss, invalid determinants or hidden use of RH.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: An independently reviewable derivation of every implication and analytic hypothesis.

candidate_bridges.statement: Prove that the stated deterministic SAT algorithm is uniform and decides NP-complete SAT within polynomial bit complexity, hence P equals NP.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Every finite input formula and every input length under standard bit-string encodings.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Correct NP-completeness reductions, representation sizes and deterministic machine execution are required.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Try arbitrary malformed encodings, exponential intermediate data and hidden oracle operations.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: Complete algorithm, correctness, complexity and reduction proofs with uniform bounds.

candidate_bridges.statement: Establish an unrestricted lower bound for all deterministic polynomial-time decision procedures for a language in NP.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: All deterministic polynomial-time Turing machines across all input lengths, no restricted proof-system shortcut.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: The chosen language must be in NP and the lower bound cannot assume any equivalent unresolved separation.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check relativization, natural-proofs scope and restricted models against the unrestricted conclusion.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A machine-model-specific unconditional separation proof under universal quantification.

candidate_bridges.statement: Connect the proposed critical estimate to global smooth unforced solutions on R3 with exact Clay A hypotheses.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Every admissible smooth divergence-free R3 datum for the official viscosity and decay conditions.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Local-to-global continuation, uniqueness, regularity and a priori estimate must cover the correct Euclidean domain.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Test concentration scenarios, scaling, tail behavior and possible dependence on a finite time cutoff.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A domain-valid global continuation theorem with every assumption independently checked.

candidate_bridges.statement: Connect the proposed critical estimate to global smooth unforced solutions on the periodic three-torus under Clay B.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Every admissible smooth divergence-free periodic datum, with forcing identically zero.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Local-to-global continuation must establish periodic and energy hypotheses without importing R3 estimates blindly.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Test high-frequency modes, periodic pressure normalization and borderline norm divergence.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A periodic global continuation theorem matching all of the official B conditions.

candidate_bridges.statement: Construct and verify a smooth forced three-dimensional Euclidean Navier-Stokes breakdown satisfying Clay C.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: An admissible smooth forcing and datum on R3 with breakdown in the exact official solution class.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Forcing decay, smoothness, finite energy and the precise nonexistence conclusion must all hold.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check whether forcing hides singular behavior or violates decay, smoothness or energy assumptions.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A fully qualified R3 forced breakdown proof with explicit PDE and force estimates.

candidate_bridges.statement: Construct and verify a smooth forced periodic three-dimensional Navier-Stokes breakdown satisfying Clay D.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Admissible smooth periodic initial conditions and forcing, with the exact stipulated failure of global smoothness.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Periodicity, divergence-free conditions, forcing regularity and full PDE identities must be proved.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check trivial forcing artifacts, periodic compatibility, hidden losses of regularity and energy bounds.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A rigorous periodic forced breakdown construction meeting every official D condition.

candidate_bridges.statement: Demonstrate that the continuum construction, axioms and regulator-uniform gap together imply the full physical Yang-Mills target.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: For each compact simple gauge group, in four Euclidean dimensions with continuum and infinite-volume limits.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Nontriviality, reflection positivity, reconstruction and physical-unit spectral interpretation are all required.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check gaps vanishing with regulator, trivial limits and nonuniform volume convergence.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A complete quantum-field reconstruction and strictly positive physical spectral-gap theorem.

candidate_bridges.statement: Show the proposed primitive-cycle construction and reduction actually cover all rational Hodge classes with correct algebraic cycle maps.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Every smooth complex projective variety, all codimensions and rational classes of Hodge type (p,p).
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Rational coefficients, cycle-class functoriality and reduction arguments must not presuppose Hodge.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check primitive exceptions, torsion confusions and mistaken use of integral Hodge claims.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A universally quantified theorem on rational algebraic cycle classes or valid counterexample.

candidate_bridges.statement: Derive the all-elliptic-curves rank equality from precisely stated analytic and arithmetic claims, distinguishing the refined formula.
candidate_bridges.quantifiers: Every elliptic curve over Q at s=1; optional refined factors require their exact normalizations.
candidate_bridges.assumptions: Analytic continuation, Selmer comparison, Sha finiteness and leading-term normalization must be explicit.
candidate_bridges.counterexample_checks: Check rank greater than one, missing factors and possible assumption of the target equality.
candidate_bridges.acceptance: A rigorously quantified proof of core BSD, and separate refined proof if that stronger claim is asserted.
